families.name: ursacoffee-first-party
families.description: Ursa's own public-facing channels (Instagram, Facebook, Rappi, CoffeePass, TripAdvisor listing). These are first-party observations, not independent verification.
families.note: Observing Ursa's own Instagram bio is first-party observation. It confirms what Ursa says about itself, not what independent sources report. Multiple first-party channels do not increase independence.

families.name: owner-unverified
families.description: Statements from the owner brief (Art Nouveau, browns/greens, bear motif). These are owner descriptions, not independently verified.
families.note: The owner brief is a starting lead, not evidence. Visual identity claims require first-party visual inspection.

families.name: hormozi-framework
families.description: Acquisition.com materials (Alex Hormozi's frameworks). One source family.
families.note: Hormozi's Value Equation is a framework, not an empirically validated law. Treat as suggestive.

families.name: sutherland-framework
families.description: Rory Sutherland's behavioral marketing principles (via FS.blog). One source family.
families.note: Sutherland's principles are influential but not café-specific empirical evidence.

families.name: industry-context
families.description: Industry publications (Fresh Cup), awards (Premios Somos, World's 100 Best), benchmarks (marginal cost), and market observations (subscription gap).
families.note: Industry publications provide context but are not Ursa-specific evidence. Award nominations are verifiable facts about competitors.

families.name: competitor-miraflores
families.description: Direct Miraflores competitors (Punto Café, Neira, Puku Puku, Terrua, Urqu). Observed via their public listings.
families.note: Competitor observations are based on their public listings at a point in time. May be stale.

families.name: competitor-lima
families.description: Lima-wide competitors (Bisetti). Observed via public listing.
families.note: Bisetti is a Barranco pioneer, not a direct Miraflores competitor.

deduplication_note: Several evidence items that appear to cite different sources (e.g., E-20 and E-21 both reference Punto Café awards) belong to the same source family. Counting them as independent corroboration would inflate the evidence base. The 29 evidence items map to 7 source families and 19 distinct sources.
